newsitem.title: USA: Brady bonds barely budge, bound by T-bond.
newsitem.headline: Brady bonds barely budge, bound by T-bond.

text.p: Emerging market debt prices barely budged Wednesday as dealers were biding their time until the debt market found fresh incentive, traders said.
Brady bonds found little inspiration to move, particularly as the U.S. Treasury bond remained confined within an extremely tight range.
"Clients have been quiet," said a Brady bond dealer at a large U.S. bank. "The only flow was in Brazil and Venezuela early in the morning, but it has been dead since then."
Dealers said local Brazilian interest dried up ahead of Brazil's Corpus Christi holiday on Thursday.
"Summertime came early," another dealer said. "There's nothing going on."
Brazil "C" bonds were unchanged at 78-3/4 bid and Argentina FRBs inched up 1/8 to 93 bid.
By late afternoon, the benchmark 30-year U.S. T-bond was unchanged to yield 7.03 percent.
Dealers forecast that it would take fresh institutional investment or some positive fundamental developments in a country like Brazil to further push Brady spreads lower.
"The market has had a good run, spreads have tightened significantly, and now it's taking a breather."
